name: illustrator-four-team-scoreboard
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 28.6 - Save a Copy > SVG (the legacy exporter: SVG Export Plug-In comment, .stN classes), Styling: Internal CSS, Responsive on
story: A media student drew the board their class quiz runs on: a heading, FOUR team rows, each a club name against a figure, a green bar they drew once per row for the moment a point lands, and an end-of-game plate. They switched the five moment layers off in the layers panel so they could see the base board while drawing it, named their layers the way docs/SVG_AUTHORING.md section 5b tells them to (Team 1, Score 1, Flash 1, Full time), and exported with Illustrator's dialog untouched, so Responsive stayed ticked and the file carries a viewBox and no width or height.
idioms: Generator comment naming the SVG Export Plug-In build
version="1.1" id="Layer_1" with x="0px" y="0px" and xml:space="preserve" on tab-indented continuation lines
Responsive export: viewBox only, no width/height attributes
<style type="text/css"> holding one property per .stN class, uppercase hex
point type as <text transform="matrix(1 0 0 1 x y)"> with the class list carrying fill, family and size separately
_x20_ escapes with data-name on every layer the student named
five hidden layers exported as class="st10" whose rule is display:none - Illustrator's shape for an eye switched off
tab indentation, one tab per nesting level
whyThisMatters: TWO OR MORE TEAMS, discovered from the artwork (owner, 2026-09-03). The scoreboard half of the 2026-09-12 production is a class quiz with four groups, not a two-team match, and every earlier scoreboard in this corpus has two - so nothing measured whether four rows survive the door, or whether the score behaviour's proposal finds them. Four promises meet here. Section 3 says a plain figure proposes a NUMBER field, which is the whole reason a +1 button can carry `current + 1`: all four score layers must arrive numeric, and a board where one of them did not would compile a control that moves a name. Section 5b says a switched-off layer is kept as a drawn moment rather than dropped, and Illustrator writes that switch as a display:none CLASS, so an importer reading only the attribute form loses all five moments silently. Section 5b also gives the naming convention this file follows exactly, so the mapping step must open with all four rows already bound - the accelerator working is the difference between a student clicking twice and a student clicking twelve times. And the board's layout IS its design, so the fit ladder must leave it alone rather than offering to widen a four-row table.
